notes: giving himself out splits λέγων from the expressed reflexive ἑαυτόν, which is a source token with its own English word; the phrasal out is the English verb's own particle.
τετρακοσίων headed on hundred, the word realizing the magnitude element of the single numeral lexeme; rule 29 does not apply, there being one source token and no juncture.
εἰς οὐδέν split, the ASV spreading the phrase over two words that each answer to a token (rules 45, 94).
